profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer
profile.summary: Versatile Full Stack Engineer with a strong track record of building fast, responsive websites using React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, and custom WordPress solutions. Known for boosting performance, integrating third-party tools, and delivering clean, scalable, client-focused results with creativity and efficiency.

positions.title: Software/Web Developer
positions.description:
-Developed and maintained highly customized websites using PHP, HTML, SCSS, Flexbox, Bootstrap, JavaScript, and jQuery, ensuring responsive, user-friendly experiences.

-Translated Figma designs into pixel-perfect, dynamic WordPress pages, working closely with design teams to ensure seamless implementation of UI/UX designs.

-Built custom WordPress themes and plugins, utilizing Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) for flexible backend interfaces tailored to client needs.

-Integrated third-party solutions, including Gravity Forms with Salesforce, to streamline data management and improve operational efficiency.

-Mentored junior developers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and fostering a collaborative team culture focused on high-quality results.

-Provided ongoing bug fixes and client-requested changes to ensure a high level of satisfaction and website performance.

-Actively participated in agile methodologies, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives to meet project deadlines and deliverables.

-Monitored and optimized Google Pagespeed scores to ensure top-notch performance and user experience.

-Built and maintained productivity/automation tools using Bash and Python3 to streamline workflows and improve team efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · WordPress · JavaScript · SCSS · jQuery · Python3 · Bash · Git · Mercurial · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Figma (Software) · Jira

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
-Led the design, development, and maintenance of dynamic websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript,and  Reactjs ensuring responsive and functional websites.

-Successfully managed multiple client projects, consistently delivering over 10 websites per quarter while adhering to deadlines and client requirements.

-Collaborated closely with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions that optimized their web presence.

-Developed custom web applications and features that enhanced website functionality, improving the overall user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · MongoDB · Gatsby.js · Contentful · JavaScript · SCSS · Git

positions.title: Customer Service & Sales Representative
positions.description:
-Delivered exceptional customer service by assisting clients with financial services and providing tailored solutions to meet their needs.

-Effectively communicated product offerings to clients, driving sales and ensuring a seamless experience from initial contact to final transaction.

-Resolved customer inquiries promptly, providing proactive support to ensure satisfaction and build long-term relationships with clients.

-Collaborated with cross-functional teams to optimize processes, improving overall efficiency and client satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Satisfaction · Customer Experience · Customer Service · Customer Retention · Sales

positions.title: Software Developer & Technical Support
positions.description:
-Developed an inventory management system using Bash, Python 2.7, automating product status tracking from receipt to shipment and improving workflow efficiency.

-Designed and integrated API solutions to automate notifications, keeping customers informed of product status in real-time.

-Provided technical support for a range of products, including wireless routers, graphics cards, and NAS devices, ensuring timely resolutions to customer issues.

-Worked with cross-functional teams to streamline processes and improve the overall customer experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Bash · Technical Support · Customer Satisfaction · Customer Retention · Customer Experience
